column2: Explainer "Flarf is a specific instantiation of this approach"
column5: Poetry magazine's July/August 2009 portfolio presented Flarf and Conceptual Writing as two distinct movements; Flarf centers on taste and "badness"
column6: Flarf is usually treated as a parallel movement rather than a branch of conceptual poetry: it shares the use of found language but leans into deliberately bad taste more than into concept over result
